1. `docs-update`: This job updates the `README.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files as per the specified requirements.
2. `memory-mcp-ci`: This job performs linting and testing for the `memory-mcp` project using Ruff and pytest.
3. `wifi-cam-mcp-ci`: This job also performs linting and testing for the `wifi-cam-mcp` project using Ruff and pytest.
